states.name: PRIOR_TREND_ESTABLISHED
states.known_at: Entirely before D impulse: MA ends D-1, lag5 MA ends D-6; previous means previous original trading session, not civil date
states.prior_information: EX007 structure group and plain trend already use MA levels/slope and ret1/5/20. EX013 strong baseline also includes distance_ma20/ma_alignment/ma_slope. EX043 TREND_CYCLE uses same slope plus D close, actual entry-day support break and <=1 priorATR.
states.unanswered_increment: Freeze this state at the original first positive-profit SHOCK D and ask the same actual cycle's exit responsibility. This is a different decision domain from EX043 entry-day support protection and fixed-midpoint EX007 probes; proposal uses D-1 close rather than EX043 D close.
states.counterevidence: EX007 price structure group pooled gains negative across H5/10/20; ordinary structure2026 benefit had opposite2023-25 behavior. EX043 trend protection activates only2020/2023 cycles, so it did not establish the proposed all-held SHOCK-role efficacy. Existing models could already represent related information.
states.not_claimed: New feature, independent alpha, established causal trend regime, or proof that all trend-true cycles should hold

states.name: FINAL_DAY_DOMINATES_RET5
states.formula: r1=log(C_D/C_Dminus1); r4=log(C_Dminus1/C_Dminus5); state=r1>r4; exact tie false; all values finite; original SHOCK domain has r1+r4>0
states.known_at: D close only, before D-to-next-E trading decision; not known before the D move starts
states.prior_information: EX007 simple baseline already has ret1/5; EX013 tested20-day positive/negative concentration, largest absolute share, signed return_center and jump_trend, plus annual-training-median direct concentration contrasts. These are adjacent old temporal-shape hypotheses, with weak strong-baseline incremental evidence.
states.unanswered_increment: Specific fixed5-day final-day-versus-prior4 signed log-return equality at a positive-profit SHOCK exit was not found as an explicit tested rule in the inspected routes. It is deterministic transformation/role reuse of existing returns, not independent new data.
states.counterevidence: EX013 concentration had some positive direct contrasts but no robust strong-baseline incremental support. r4 can be negative: state true then means a late rebound dominates net5-day change, not that most of five sessions rose. State false may include a negative D after earlier gains. The boundary is economically interpretable but still adaptively proposed after seeing history.
states.not_claimed: A discovered jump threshold, an untested new input, or that state true necessarily favors selling/holding

component_label_contract.population: Only A-authenticated original C9461 first selected_shock_exit D, actual held positive funded Q; one equal-weight row per original cycle. All21 original cycles retained including zero/censored; no alternative-path cohort selection.
component_label_contract.intervention_semantics: Freeze each state at first originalSHOCK D. For each independent alternative suppress SHOCK for the rest of that one actual cycle, not daily state reclassification or one-day deferral. Before firstSHOCK paths must coincide. No new BUY after the original supplied entry, no later original entry seeded into this branch.
component_label_contract.ON_control: Replay each original actual entry through its original actual exit. Exact source-D target/mandatory/risk/support/GRACE flags, all actual SELL attempts, filldate/trigger/price/Q/fee must match, not only final liquidation price. Authenticate actual originalBUY cost and IDs first.
component_label_contract.OFF_other_rules: Keep cost1ATR, S5 support, original actual-entryD-only GRACE, entry-index H10 deadline and blockedSELL pending continuation. Inheritedpending/expiry outrank risk; OFF cannot cancel pending. Reservations retained as provenance, pause feedback cannot create a later entry in a one-cycle label.
component_label_contract.unit: delta_return=(Q*alt_exit_price-alt_exit_fee - (Q*ON_exit_price-ON_exit_fee))/(Q*actual_entry_price+actual_buy_fee). With exact proportional.001 costs, equivalent .999*(alt_price-ON_price)/(entry_price*1.001). All numerator/denominator prices same original anchoredHFQ ledger basis and quantities RESEARCH_UNIT. Runtime fullHFQ features/entry prices kept separately; original anchor5.892 mapping authenticated.
component_label_contract.sign: Strict negative/zero/positive, no new epsilon for outcome signs; exact equality zero. Tolerance if needed only predeclared arithmetic identity rounding, not public fill predicates or label classification.
component_label_contract.common_terminal_cash: ON sale cash frozen without interest or reentry while alternative remains held; compare both liquidation proceeds at their common post-liquidation point under original cutoff. This is local liquidation opportunity cost, not an account return, annual alpha, cash participation benefit or additive budget.
component_label_contract.cutoff: Only original valid D-to-E schedule through final sourceD2026-10-14 and executionE2026-10-15. Original pending SELL may execute finalE; no invented closeD10/15 signal or postcutoff fill. Either arm unresolved at cutoff: censored with null delta/sign, retain age/known state/attempt history; no terminal mark substituted into liquidation label.
component_label_contract.descriptive_controls: Per-year counts/labels including empty2022; state known/true/false/unknown; actual entry-day age0 vs age>=1 and each exact remaining deadline count, plus actual extra liquidation duration. Report state-label cells and adverse examples, no tuned bins/new minimum counts/CI/noharm economic gate.
component_label_contract.downstream_limit: A future full policy must decide on the first actualSHOCK of its own cycle and latch any hold choice until actual sale. It must separately reevaluate own later entries, loss feedback, quantity and capital under original full7-year goals. This component cannot answer that total value.
